stop: Stop on plateau/regression. Continue only if total visual score gains at least 6 of 240, at least six of twelve cases improve, and improvements outnumber regressions; any isolation/tool/image violation disqualifies a round. Compiler acceptance and warnings are recorded separately.
input: Original briefs/targets only, fresh sessions and separate empty directories. No supplied sources, interviews, reviewer critiques or images enter generations.
feedback: Existing part search and compiler counts/errors only; no render feedback, recipes, geometric solver or construction-warning feedback.
baseline: Current independent Sol E and frozen diorama results; historical original pixel-like Piplup is a preference reference, not generation input.
evaluation: Same Standard look, 1280x960, iso/front/iso-back/top. Evaluate accepted unmodified sources before interviewing those sessions. One sample per brief/style/round is exploratory, not statistical proof.
scriptPolicy: Inspect script feedback/search/part metadata from interviews. Make only small general changes with measured evidence; do not add visual help or subject-specific macros.
